edges.label: same_fact
edges.reason: Both quotes are from the same source and refer to the same set of 12 people issued exclusion orders. The NEW quote specifies 'the 12 people' and the EXISTING quote specifies 'at least 12 people'.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-02, The Guardian reported “Melbourne activists Violet Coco and Brad Homewood are among the 12 people issued an exclusion order by WA police.”; on the same day, The Guardian reported “Activists and a Greens MP have threatened legal action after the Western Australia police banned at least 12 people entering a designated security area where the Land Forces weapons expo will be held in Perth from 6 October.”.
